# Omarchy Multi-Monitor Workspaces

Omarchy Multi-Monitor Workspaces manages predictable Hyprland workspace placement across multiple displays. The site covers installation, behavior, and configuration.

## Documentation

- Overview: https://bolens.github.io/omarchy-multi-monitor-workspaces/
